name: Tyrique Daniel
headline: SENIOR BACKEND & PLATFORM ENGINEER
summary: Senior Backend and Platform Engineer with 8+ years of experience building APIs, distributed systems, event-driven services, cloud infrastructure, and data-processing platforms. Strong background in Python, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Apache Pulsar, Kubernetes, AWS, and Google Cloud. Experienced in designing scalable backend architectures, asynchronous processing systems, observability platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and large-scale data workflows for AI-enabled products.

Built observability across distributed services with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Tempo, improving bottleneck detection and production diagnostics.
Developed backend services and workflow orchestration integrating APIs, CRM platforms, LLMs, and structured business rules.
Engineered PySpark and Pandas pipelines processing 140M+ records for enrichment, scoring, and personalization.
Supported 40% growth in platform workloads without performance degradation through scalable service and infrastructure design.

Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, reducing manual iOS and Android deployment errors by 60%.
Integrated AI speech workflows with AWS, Apache Ray, and Kubernetes, reducing inference latency by 40%.
